answer: Derivable from ../sldb/src/sldb/api/__init__.py: it exports the needed writes (track_document_file, untrack_document, add_model, remove_model, create_document, delete_document, save_document_payload, update_store_indexes, init_store) plus resolve_model_ref and open_store, so PRIVATE_SLDB_IMPORTS can be empty.
Normal depends_on ordering, not a defect: the dependency task defines deskops/errors.py (DomainError=1, UsageError=2, DeskopsEnvironmentError=3); a closeout abort raises one of those.

Prefix binds to module names (create_document.py, delete_document.py, track_document_file.py, untrack_document.py under ../sldb/src/sldb/api/documents; no update_* module). But 'anything under sldb.cli' is over-broad: identity.py:6, repo.py:7-8, message.py:11-12 import read-side sldb.cli, so the scan cannot pass.

payload is the model field dict, same as existing _write_doc(path, model, payload) (operations.py:2223), rendered with render_model_markdown(model, payload); file bytes are read/written inside doc_io.

Public read exists: sldb.api.doc_status/doc_exists (../sldb/src/sldb/api/stores/doc_status.py:18,36; exported in ../sldb/src/sldb/api/__init__.py), so is_tracked(root, path) can wrap doc_exists via open_store with no private read.

tx.delete semantics unstated. Fix: say whether it unlinks only (caller pairs tx.untrack, as the closeout does) or also untracks; deleting a tracked file without untracking leaves an orphan store entry and breaks sldb stores check.
Writes are eager; commit only discards the journal (step 5: only the outermost exit commits or rolls back). No store work happens at commit.
Already stated in step 5: rollback restores store entries first, then file bytes, and if restoring fails it logs that and re-raises the original error.
'Module-level stack keyed by root' implies per-root transactions (different root = separate transaction); the CLI is single-threaded, so no thread-safety requirement.
doc_io is the only sldb caller, so monkeypatch the sldb names it imports (e.g. deskops.doc_io.track_document_file) to raise; the task already says 'monkeypatch the sldb call to raise'.

'Store writes ... also move' = only the calls move: _untrack_atom_document (operations.py:1784-1792) and _retarget_atom_documents (operations.py:1755-1772) keep the helpers as thin delegates to doc_io.

runs/planning/sldb-requests.md does not exist (find returns nothing), so the executor creates it; Scope already fixes its content as (function, why, proposed API); nothing gates closeout on coordinator action.

Existing atom desk/atoms/workflow-model/atom-create-operations-should-rollback-on-failure.md already carries the rule and never names _with_rollback, so renaming pill-012's How to DocTransaction needs no atom change.
sldb.api.check_store (../sldb/src/sldb/api/stores/store_check.py:13, exported in ../sldb/src/sldb/api/__init__.py) is the API the CLI uses, so tests can call it instead of shelling out.
